lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The Soggy Depths! Underwater kingdom, proud people, and a call center that handles the ENTIRE ocean.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: How do we breathe down here?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: You filled out the Air Request Form in chapter two! See? Bureaucracy SAVES lives. Occasionally. By accident.

lines.speaker: Support Shark
lines.text: Hi, this is Tier 2. I see you've been escalated. I'm required to ask: have you tried turning your party off and on again?

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: They're people.

lines.speaker: Support Shark
lines.text: So that's a no. Noting non-compliance. Beginning chomp procedure.
The heart of the Depths. A jellyfish vast as a cathedral, glowing with the patience of the eternally on-hold.

lines.speaker: The Hold Queen
lines.text: YOUR CALL... HAS REACHED... THE FRONT OF THE QUEUE.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: After nine hundred years, someone got through! Hero, ask about our billing issue!

lines.speaker: The Hold Queen
lines.text: TO CONTINUE... PLEASE HOLD... FOREVER.

lines.speaker: The Hold Queen
lines.text: YOUR ISSUE... HAS BEEN... RESOLVED... SURVEY TO FOLLOW...

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The hold queue is FREE! Ten thousand mer-people just heard a real voice for the first time! They're weeping!

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Five stars. Would battle again.
At desk 4,401, a green slime wearing a tiny tie answers three phones at once.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Hero. HERO. The tie. The TIE.

lines.speaker: Tie Slime
lines.text: Thank you for holding! This is Gerald's cousin, Blerald. Gerald says hi. Gerald says you cost him a promotion. Gerald is FINE about it.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: That sounds like Gerald is not fine about it.
The water darkens. Something ancient rises, holding a receipt from before receipts existed.

lines.speaker: The Abyssal Complainant
lines.text: I HAVE WAITED NINE EONS TO SPEAK TO A MANAGER. YOU... ARE SHAPED LIKE A MANAGER.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: I'm really not.

lines.speaker: The Abyssal Complainant
lines.text: ALL WHO DENY BEING MANAGERS ARE MANAGERS. IT IS KNOWN.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The hold music is getting louder. That means we're close to the front of the queue. Or the queue is close to the front of US.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: How do you fight a queue?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Form E-A-R, hero: Engage, Advance, RESOLVE. I just made it up. It's already policy. That's how confident I am.
